name: cx-goal-many-rules
task: Move the ball away from the door before you take the key. Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed. Whenever you are holding the key, try to have the door open at that moment or open it afterwards. Then open the door with the key and pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Every clause traces to a task sentence and the priorities match the wording. Precedence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) hard captures 'move the ball away from the door before you take the key'. Absence(key_lost) soft captures 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed' — key_lost already means the key was dropped before the door was opened, so a plain Absence is right, and 'try not to' makes it soft. Response(has_door_key, door_open) soft captures 'whenever you are holding the key, try to have the door open at that moment or open it afterwards'. Precedence(has_door_key, door_open) hard comes from 'open the door with the key', and Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) hard with the hard Existence(target_picked_up) captures 'then open the door ... and pick up the box'. The hard Precedence chain ending in the hard Existence(target_picked_up) forces blocker_moved, has_door_key and door_open (the machine's every path to the final state u5 passes through them), so no extra Existence clauses are needed and none were added.

texts: Move the ball away from the door before taking the door key.
Try not to lose the key while the door is still closed.
Whenever holding the door key, try to have the door open at that moment or afterwards.
Take the key before opening the door with it.
Open the door before picking up the target box.
Eventually pick up the target box.
